subject.title: feat(telegram): support Telegram Business Connect (secretary mode)

question: Should OpenClaw ship Telegram Business Connect as a bundled Telegram-plugin capability now, and must its first supported scope include account-isolated routing plus consistent command/action behavior?
rationale: This feature intentionally lets a bot process private traffic and reply on a connected business identity; maintainers need to set the supported interaction and safety contract rather than having the contributor infer it from an incomplete MVP.

options.title: Approve a bounded Business Connect contract
options.body: Require account-scoped persistence, update parity, explicit handling for every supported outbound action, and real connected-account proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the feature direction
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open for product and privacy-policy design, then invite a narrower implementation once the supported scope is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded Business Connect contract
recommendation.body: Require account-scoped persistence, update parity, explicit handling for every supported outbound action, and real connected-account proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires a bundled-channel product and private-message boundary decision, not only a mechanical code correction.
